notes.en: [[character:ye-shunguang]] needs a lot of field time to build Qingming Sword Force. Stunners that need little field time, such as [[character:trigger]] and [[character:ju-fufu]], work best.
Target stats at level 60: ATK 3,000+, HP 10,000+, DEF 600+ and CRIT DMG 180 to 200%+. Keep CRIT Rate at about 50% or less on the stat screen.

[[character:dialyn]] is one of the easiest ways to enter the Enlightened Mind State, since each Ye Shunguang Ultimate gives 6 Sword Force. Her 30% Stun DMG multiplier also applies out of Stun with Ether Veil: Verdict.

[[character:zhao]] is a particularly good partner, because frequent Ether Veil activations give 3 Sword Force each, and she needs very little field time. [[character:sunna]] is among her best teammates, supplying Sword Force on average every 25 seconds or less.

[[character:trigger]] and [[character:ju-fufu]] add personal bonuses. [[character:seed]] looks anti-synergistic at first because Ye Shunguang builds no Energy in the Enlightened Mind State, but Seed's buffs still help a lot.
The W-Engine ranking was calculated with [[character:dialyn]] (Yesterday Calls) and [[character:zhao]] (Half-Sugar Bunny) as teammates. Percentages are relative to her signature.
